status: frozen before T3-v2 generation or any physician scoring
dataset: VQA-RAD official test OE; identical outcome-blind one-question-per-image substrate as v1

repair_trigger.observed_failure: three of four completed Huatuo clinical arms exceeded the frozen 5% cap-hit ceiling
repair_trigger.repair_rule: increase the common native generation ceiling once from 256 to 512 for every model and clinical arm

generation.stop: model EOS or native template separator only

temperature_length_controls.selection: single outcome-independent repair; no held-out answer, automatic judge, or physician label selects an arm
temperature_length_controls.legacy_length_controls: v1 greedy128/greedy256 remain diagnostic and cannot enter the v2 clinical efficacy comparison

self_consistency.inclusion: a structured claim key must occur in at least 3 of 5 independently seeded samples
self_consistency.state_resolution: a state requires at least 3 of 5 votes; otherwise retain the claim as uncertain conflict
self_consistency.unknown_handling: unparsed spans remain in the trace and cannot be credited as corrected or silently dropped

oe_qualification.failure_policy: no physician efficacy pack; preserve as identity/termination evidence and stop this method branch

clinical_analysis.promotion: physician claim error improves with no omission, length, coverage, or refusal exchange
